verdict.rationale: Teller documents raw ledger transactions with categorization and live balances marketed for underwriting. Nothing in the evidence shows recurring-stream detection, payroll or income identification, or an income-verification product. Category labels and balance checks are adjacent building blocks a developer could use to derive such signals, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform derives income and cash-flow signals from connected accounts — recurring streams, payroll detection, or documented income verification products built on the same data
